newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's Prodi to meet party leaders on budget.
newsitem.headline: Italy's Prodi to meet party leaders on budget.

text.p: Italian Prime Minister Romano Prodi will meet the Senate (upper house) leaders of his ruling centre-left coalition at 1600 GMT to discuss his 1997 budget, political sources said.
The leaders are due to present mediation proposals to the centre-right opposition to try to iron out differences over Prodi's 62.5 trillion lire ($40.7 billion) 1997 budget.
Opposition leaders were due to decide on Wednesday whether or not to boycott a vote on the package in the Senate.
The budget, currently before the Senate budget commission, is due to go to the full upper house chamber on December 10.
After approval it will be sent back to the lower Chamber of Deputies for voting on changes made by the Senate. The entire process must by law be completed by the end of the month. ($1=1,534 lire)
